search_parameters.q: Is GST charged on individual health insurance premiums in India?

header: No—GST is not charged on individual health insurance premiums in India anymore; the rate has been 0% since 22 September 2025.

text_blocks.snippet: ✅ Current GST Rate for Individual Health Insurance

list.snippet: GST on all individual health insurance policies is 0% as of 22 September 2025 3 .
snippet_highlighted_words: GST on all individual health insurance policies is 0%

text_blocks.snippet: The exemption applies to both new purchases and renewals, as long as the premium payment date is on or after 22 September 2025 Ditto Insurance .

list.snippet: Group health insurance (employer-provided or bank-provided) continues to be taxed at 18% GST 3 .
Reinsurance for group policies also remains at 18% 1 .

text_blocks.snippet: The 56th GST Council meeting (September 2025) removed GST on individual health insurance to make coverage more affordable and increase insurance penetration in India Ditto Insurance+1 .
A 60-year-old in Delhi now pays ₹49,168 instead of ₹58,018 for a ₹15 lakh policy—because the earlier 18% GST no longer applies Ditto Insurance .
If your renewal falls after 22 September 2025 and you pay on or after that date, your insurer must apply 0% GST automatically Ditto Insurance .

table: Applies to all retail plans and their reinsurance 3

formatted.notes: Applies to all retail plans and their reinsurance 3

text_blocks.snippet: If you are buying or renewing your own personal health insurance policy, you do NOT pay GST anymore. Only group/corporate policies still carry the 18% tax.
